description: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:474 — the PathCandidates rustdoc body has `[AKI-ranked order](rank_candidates)` but rank_candidates is a private fn. With RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps -p pkix-path-builder --all-features (the workspace pre-push check per AGENTS.md) this fails with: error: public documentation for `PathCandidates` links to private item `rank_candidates`. Trigger: any pre-1.0 doc-deny-warnings run, any docs.rs build with default settings if the crate's metadata uses --cfg docsrs (it does). Fix: remove the intra-doc link (just say "in AKI-ranked order") or document the algorithm inline instead of cross-linking the private helper.
title: cargo doc --all-features fails: PathCandidates rustdoc links to private rank_candidates
